text:
maria: External pentest kickoff next Tue (staging). Scope: RBAC checks, KMS evidence upload, audit trails. Assessor needs temp log access + presigned S3 uploads. No PII. Please review below and reply by EOD.

steven: Recommend 1h ephemeral sessions by default. Can allow a single 4h escalation with approval.

maria: 1h default works. Tag sessions with pt:assessor and log assume-role events.

jordan: Use STS assume-role with session policy limiting s3/kms. Example policy will deny non-s3 kms operations and require kms:ViaService == s3.amazonaws.com.

emily: Audit retention ask: app logs 90d, infra/cloudtrail 365d. Enable high-fidelity traces on findings export. Default sampling 5%.

steven: Presigned POSTs expire 15m. Use SSE-KMS and require x-amz-server-side-encryption to equal our pt key. Include integrity-hash metadata and assessor id in filename.

devsec-bot: Created SEC-4242 (PT runbook + ephemeral roles + KMS grants + audit export). Link: https://redwood.example/SEC-4242

oncall-ops: Dry-run Wed 10:00 UTC. Need an eng-runtime + security lead on-call. Who owns rollback?

maria: I'll be security lead. @steven please own rollback playbook.

steven: I will. I'll open a small PR with assume-role + bucket policy.

emily: I'll make the triage sheet with severity, owner, PR, ETA, retest flag and post link.

jordan: Ensure cloudtrail->SIEM keeps request tags and session tags so assessor actions map to findings.

maria: Added to SEC-4242 checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
